Content:
Fresh code-health corrections for the 2026-09-07 animation-MVP branch. Use this record to supersede stale statements in older Working memories when they conflict with current source. [C] GeneratedCreature no longer exposes MainMesh; production callers use TryGetImplicitSurface and the old accessor remains only as a regression assertion. [C] GeneratedCreatureData now defensively copies its Color[] input and exposes IReadOnlyList<Color>; CreatureMeshGenerator materializes a copy only at the Unity Mesh.SetColors boundary. [C] GenerationDiagnostics now exposes genuine read-only views and marks FailedStage for every exception escaping a timed stage, so Succeeded remains consistent with the scheduler's all-exceptions failure model. [C] ValidationResult caches IsValid and exposes a read-only issue view. [C] SkeletonSnapshot enforces exactly one root, parent-before-child ordering, and structural compatibility checks. [C] SkeletonSnapshot pending ordering is now implemented with a SortedSet keyed by the existing ordinal bone-ID comparer, preserving observable ordering while removing RemoveAt(0) and repeated whole-list sorting. [C] explicit terminal limb joint nodes exist for every LimbChain; the terminal node is the authored final joint, so missing ankle/wrist nodes are not invented and child attachment routes through the terminal joint. [C] compact body rig topology is independent of body sampling density, and its body-spine radius uses the midpoint of the spine's own canonical interval. [C] RigDebugView lazily initializes GUIStyle and preserves Unity Selection during framing operations. [I/C] Bone and Skeleton remain mutable builder-side derived-state objects; future migration should introduce an internal builder or immutable constructed representation only with compatibility tests, because SkeletonSnapshot is the current runtime compatibility boundary. [C] TSK-0153 grounding is intentionally not implemented until designated foot contact geometry has one explicit source-of-truth; lowest-vertex or arbitrary-foot-origin heuristics are prohibited by the task contract.

Durable engineering preference: prefer narrow reusable utility methods and bridges, eliminate duplicate policy implementations, consolidate raw/resolved entry points at the resolved snapshot boundary, and harden collection/result handoff boundaries against mutation. Track each concrete finding with a tsk-#### record before closing it. Do not claim Unity-gated completion from source or dotnet build evidence alone. When MemorySmith is unavailable, hand-maintained Data/Memories JSON on the isolated audit branch is the fallback and should include provenance, confidence, source links, and explicit supersession/correction language.
Title: CreatureCreator Current Code-Health Corrections
